title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star in the Snow with Lulu | Nursery Rhyme
description:
Sing along to Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star with Lulu the little duck on a snowy winter night! A friendly snowman waves on every "twinkle", soft snow begins to fall and Penguin waddles in to listen.
The words light up with the music, for children aged 2 to 6.
A classic nursery rhyme (words by Jane Taylor, 1806; traditional French tune, 1761).
